tooltip: Scene Mode – Allows you to select predefined scene modes for optimal image capture
content1: Allows you to select from predefined scene modes optimized for specific capture scenarios. The camera adjusts exposure, white balance, and other parameters based on the selected scene.
content2:
sceneModes Enum indicates the scene mode:
  1. SCENE_NORMAL (0x01) – Normal scene mode.
  2. SCENE_DOCUMENT (0x0C) – Document scene mode for text and documents.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current scene mode from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the scene mode on the camera.

tooltip: Special Effects – Allows you to apply special effects filters to the video output
content1: Allows you to apply special effect filters to the video stream. Available effects include normal (no filter), black and white, greyscale, negative, and sketch effects.
content2:
specialEffects Enum indicates the effect mode:
  1. EFFECT_NORMAL (0x01) – Normal (no effect).
  2. EFFECT_BLACK_WHITE (0x04) – Black and white effect.
  3. EFFECT_GREYSCALE (0x07) – Greyscale effect.
  4. EFFECT_NEGATIVE (0x08) – Negative effect.
  5. EFFECT_SKETCH (0x10) – Sketch effect.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current special effect mode from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the special effect mode on the camera.

tooltip: Denoise – Allows you to adjust the noise reduction level
content1: Allows you to control the level of noise reduction applied to the video stream. Higher values provide more aggressive noise reduction but may reduce image detail.
content2:
1. getDenoiseValue retrieves the current denoise value.
2. setDenoiseValue sets the denoise value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current denoise value from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the denoise value on the camera.

tooltip: Q Factor – Allows you to adjust the JPEG compression quality factor
content1: Allows you to control the JPEG compression quality factor. Lower values result in more compression and smaller file sizes, while higher values improve image quality.
content2:
1. getQFactor retrieves the current Q factor (JPEG quality).
2. setQFactor sets the Q factor value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current Q factor (JPEG quality) from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the Q factor (JPEG quality) on the camera.

tooltip: iHDR Mode – Allows you to enable and configure HDR (High Dynamic Range) mode
content1: Allows you to enable HDR mode for improved dynamic range capture. HDR can be disabled, set to automatic adjustment, or manually configured with a specific HDR value.
content2:
camiHDRMode Enum indicates the HDR mode:
  1. HdrOff (0x01) – HDR disabled.
  2. HdrAuto (0x02) – Automatic HDR adjustment.
  3. HdrManual (0x03) – Manual HDR with specific value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current HDR mode and value from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the HDR mode and value on the camera.

tooltip: Stream Mode – Allows you to set the streaming trigger mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to set the streaming trigger mode. The camera can operate in free-running master mode or wait for an external hardware trigger.
content2:
camStreamMode Enum indicates the streaming mode:
  1. STREAM_MASTER (0x00) – Free-running (master) mode.
  2. STREAM_TRIGGER (0x01) – External trigger mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current stream mode from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the stream mode on the camera.

tooltip: Flicker Detection – Allows you to suppress fluorescent light flicker at 50 Hz or 60 Hz
content1: Allows you to enable anti-flicker suppression to reduce banding artifacts caused by fluorescent or LED lighting at 50 Hz or 60 Hz power line frequencies.
content2:
camFlickerMode Enum indicates the flicker suppression mode:
  1. MODE_AUTO (0x00) – Automatic flicker detection.
  2. MODE_50Hz (0x01) – 50 Hz suppression.
  3. MODE_60Hz (0x02) – 60 Hz suppression.
  4. MODE_DISABLE (0x03) – Flicker detection disabled.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flicker detection mode from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the flicker detection mode on the camera.

tooltip: Orientation – Allows you to set the image flip or mirror orientation
content1: Allows you to flip or mirror the output image horizontally and/or vertically. This is useful for correcting the image orientation based on the physical camera mounting.
content2:
1. getOrientation retrieves the current flip/mirror orientation.
2. setOrientation sets the horizontal and vertical flip modes.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current image orientation from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the image orientation on the camera.

tooltip: Burst Length – Allows you to set the number of frames in burst capture mode
content1: Allows you to configure the number of frames captured in burst capture mode. This is useful for capturing multiple frames in rapid succession.
content2:
1. getBurstLength retrieves the current burst length.
2. setBurstLength sets the burst length value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current burst length from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the burst length on the camera.

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Allows you to configure the auto-exposure region of interest
content1: Allows you to configure the region of interest (ROI) used for auto-exposure calculations. The ROI can cover the full frame or be set to a manual window with a specific position and size.
content2:
camROIAutoExpMode Enum indicates the ROI mode for auto-exposure:
  1. AE_Face (0x00) – Face detection mode.
  2. AE_Full (0x01) – Full-frame auto-exposure.
  3. AE_Manual (0x02) – Manual ROI window.
  4. AE_Disabled (0x03) – Auto-exposure disabled.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure ROI configuration from the camera.
setAPIHeading: bool setROIAutoExposure(camROIAutoExpMode see3camAutoexpROIMode, uint vidResolnWidth, uint vidResolnHeight, uint xCord, uint yCord, QString winSize)
setAPIDes: This function configures the auto-exposure ROI mode on the camera.

tooltip: Exposure Compensation – Allows you to adjust the desired exposure of the camera
content1: Allows you to adjust the wanted exposure of the camera without changing the aperture or shutter speed. This value is relative to what the camera's built-in light meter considers as proper exposure.
content2:
1. getExposureCompensation retrieves the current exposure compensation value.
2. setExposureCompensation sets the exposure compensation value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current exposure compensation from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the exposure compensation on the camera.

tooltip: Frame Rate Control – Allows you to set the frame rate for video streaming
content1: Allows you to configure the frame rate for video streaming. This is useful for reducing bandwidth usage or adapting to the processing capabilities of the host system.
content2:
1. getFrameRateCtrlValue retrieves the current frame rate setting.
2. setFrameRateCtrlValue sets the frame rate for the camera.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current frame rate setting from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the frame rate on the camera.

tooltip: Face Detection – Enables face detection and configures embedding and overlay options
content1: Allows you to enable face detection on the camera to identify and track faces in the video stream. You can also enable embedded data and overlay rectangles for detected faces.
content2:
camFaceDetectMode – Face detection enable/disable.
camFaceDetectEmbedDataMode – Embedded metadata enable/disable.
camFaceDetectOverlayRect – Overlay rectangle enable/disable.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current face detection settings from the camera.
setAPIHeading: bool setFaceDetectionRect(bool enableFaceDetectRect, bool embedData, bool overlayRect)
setAPIDes: This function configures face detection on the camera.

tooltip: Smile Detection – Enables smile detection and face recognition features
content1: Allows you to enable smile detection to identify and track smiling faces in the video stream. You can also enable embedded metadata for smile detection events.
content2:
camSmileDetectMode – Smile detection enable/disable.
camSmileDetectEmbedDataMode – Embedded metadata enable/disable.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current smile detection settings from the camera.
setAPIDes: This function configures smile detection on the camera.

tooltip: Face Rectangle – Enables or disables the face detection rectangle overlay
content1: Allows you to enable or disable the rectangle overlay that indicates detected faces in the video stream. This provides visual feedback about which regions the camera has identified as faces.
content2: enableDisableFaceRectangle enables or disables the face rectangle overlay on detected faces.
struct1:
// Uses bool parameter to enable/disable face rectangle
bool enableDisableFaceRectangle(bool enableRFRect);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current face detection settings including rectangle status.
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables the face rectangle overlay on the camera.

tooltip: Serial Number – Displays the serial number of the camera
content1: Displays the serial number of the camera. This is a read-only property used for device identification.
content2: The See3CAM_CU135 SDK class does not provide a serial number API; this field is not read through the See3CAM_CU135 HID command set.
getAPIDes: There is no See3CAM_CU135-specific get function for the serial number.
getAPICode: // No See3CAM_CU135-specific API for Serial Number.
setAPIDes: Serial Number is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode: // No set API available for Serial Number.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Displays the firmware version of the camera
content1: Displays the firmware version currently running on the camera. This is a read-only property used to identify the firmware on the device.
content2: The See3CAM_CU135 SDK class does not provide a firmware version API; this field is not read through the See3CAM_CU135 HID command set.
getAPIDes: There is no See3CAM_CU135-specific get function for the firmware version.
getAPICode: // No See3CAM_CU135-specific API for Firmware Version.
setAPIDes: Firmware Version is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode: // No set API available for Firmware Version.

tooltip: Restore Default – Resets all camera settings to factory defaults
content1: Restores all camera settings to their factory default values. This resets scene mode, special effects, exposure, gain, flicker detection, orientation, face detection, smile detection, and all other configurable parameters to their original manufacturer settings.
content2: setToDefault restores all camera settings to their factory default values. This is a comprehensive reset operation.
getAPIDes: Restores all camera settings to factory default values.
setAPIDes: Restores all camera settings to factory default values.
